basic_info.description: Outstanding, completely detached Sunset home on a large 32x120 ft lot (per tax records). Spacious living room with fireplace and large picture window overlooking green belt. Formal dining room with ornate built-in hutch, 3BRs on main level & original kitchen & full bath. Mud room off kitchen opens into deep back yard with lush garden. Fabulous woodwork, wainscoting, period detailing & HW flrs throughout. Freshly painted inside and out. Extra large garage can fit at least two cars with plenty of storage & washer/dryer. Great location--half block to Irving St. & Golden Gate Park. Very transit friendly. Also short drive to Ocean Beach.
